title: Display earnings/dividend dates, short interest, and insider transactions
description: Surface the newly-exposed earnings/dividend dates, short interest, and insider-transaction data (backend-market-data-extra-fields) on the stock detail page as a new panel. The earnings-date warning is the highest-value piece -- Elder's own rationale is explicit ('a nasty earnings surprise can do serious damage to your position... can jump straight past any stop level') -- so it should be visually prominent, not buried, when a position or a fresh BUY signal falls within the warning window. Handle the Stooq-fallback unavailability case explicitly (show 'unavailable' distinctly from 'checked, nothing found') rather than a silent blank. Per the project's established explanatory pattern (common/InfoBalloon, common/MetricHelp, metricHelpContent.ts, signalExplanation.ts, docs/tasks/frontend-stock-detail-metric-help.json), every new visual element this task adds must be explainable, not just displayed: a help affordance (reuse MetricHelp where it fits) that states what the metric/signal is, how it relates to Dr. Elder's methodology, and, where meaningful, an explanation of the CURRENT value shown -- not a static definition alone. Add an entry to metricHelpContent.ts's registry rather than inventing a parallel explanation mechanism.

checklist.step: Design the panel layout (earnings/dividend dates, short interest metrics, recent insider transactions) and the prominent earnings-warning treatment for positions/signals within the warning window.
Implement, handling the 'data unavailable on this provider path' case explicitly and distinctly from 'no data found.'

MetricHelp content explaining each field (what short-percent-of-float and days-to-cover mean and why a squeeze matters for a BUY; why 3+ insider buys/sells in a month is treated as meaningful but a single transaction isn't).
Tests + Storybook story; confirm 90% coverage gate holds.
